constraints.name: profiles_current_leader_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (current_leader_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: profiles_email_format
constraints.definition: CHECK (((email IS NULL) OR ((char_length(email) <= 254) AND (email = lower(TRIM(BOTH FROM email))) AND (email ~ '^[^[:space:]<>@]+@[^[:space:]<>@]+\.[^[:space:]<>@]+$'::text))))

constraints.name: profiles_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: profiles_original_inviter_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (original_inviter_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

profile_indexes.name: idx_profiles_inviter
profile_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_profiles_inviter ON public.profiles USING btree (original_inviter_id)

profile_indexes.name: idx_profiles_leader
profile_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_profiles_leader ON public.profiles USING btree (current_leader_id)

profile_indexes.name: profiles_email_uidx
profile_indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX profiles_email_uidx ON public.profiles USING btree (email) WHERE (email IS NOT NULL)

profile_indexes.name: profiles_pkey
profile_indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX profiles_pkey ON public.profiles USING btree (id)

indexes.name: founders50_reviews_application_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX founders50_reviews_application_idx ON public.founders50_reviews USING btree (application_id, created_at DESC)

indexes.name: founders50_reviews_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX founders50_reviews_pkey ON public.founders50_reviews USING btree (id)

indexes.name: founders50_reviews_reviewer_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX founders50_reviews_reviewer_idx ON public.founders50_reviews USING btree (reviewer_id, created_at DESC)

indexes.name: share_assets_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX share_assets_pkey ON public.share_assets USING btree (id)

indexes.name: share_assets_slug_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX share_assets_slug_key ON public.share_assets USING btree (slug)

indexes.name: share_assets_status_sort_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX share_assets_status_sort_idx ON public.share_assets USING btree (status, featured DESC, sort_order, title)

indexes.name: share_assets_translation_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX share_assets_translation_idx ON public.share_assets USING btree (translation_key, language_code, status)

indexes.name: share_assets_translation_language_unique
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX share_assets_translation_language_unique ON public.share_assets USING btree (translation_key, language_code)

triggers.name: apply_founders50_review_decision_trigger
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER apply_founders50_review_decision_trigger AFTER INSERT ON public.founders50_reviews FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION app_private.apply_founders50_review_decision()

triggers.name: default_share_translation_key_trigger
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER default_share_translation_key_trigger BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF slug, translation_key ON public.share_assets FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION app_private.default_translation_key_from_slug()

triggers.name: normalize_share_asset_trigger
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER normalize_share_asset_trigger BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.share_assets FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION app_private.normalize_share_asset()

triggers.name: validate_share_asset_translation_family_trigger
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER validate_share_asset_translation_family_trigger BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF translation_key, asset_type ON public.share_assets FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION app_private.validate_share_asset_translation_family()

constraints.name: founders50_reviews_application_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (application_id) REFERENCES founders50_applications(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: founders50_reviews_reviewer_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (reviewer_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
